messages:
ellie: Heads-up: billing export schema changed overnight (provider renamed label key `team_owner` -> `owner_team`) and our mapper treated those lines as "unassigned". Impacting ~4,560 USD across APAC and US. Filing here for quick decision on reallocation.

cost-scraper-bot: export link: https://redwood.internal/billing/3305000000-schema-diff.csv (preview shows provider_key mismatch).

raj (finance): can you show a compact breakdown by present owner tag? we need to know which teams would be affected before approving any rebill.

mike-ops: ran a quick map using fallback logic (match on `owner` OR `team`) -> proposed split: Core-Search $2,100; Platform-Playground $1,250; Ads-ML $920; Misc infra $290.

hannah (product): Playground product lead here: will need signoff for $1,250. Also want note that we should avoid rebilling if confidence < 0.7. What's the confidence?

mike-ops: confidence scores: Core-Search 0.95, Playground 0.82, Ads-ML 0.74, Misc 0.60. I flagged misc below threshold.

raj (finance): finance rule: do not auto-rebill anything with confidence < 0.75. So misc $290 stays on unallocated for now; rest OK if product leads sign. Need ledger strings.

ellie: pinged product owners: @liam-search approved via DM, @hannah approved in-thread :thumbsup:, @amy-ads approved DM.

mike-ops: created JIRA FIN-2026-410 "Billing schema change - retro allocation 3305000000" and attached csv + mapping diff.

raj (finance): JE narrative to include: "Retro allocation due to provider billing key rename; mapper fallback used; owners approved in slack; misc below confidence retained as unallocated." Ledger: LDG-CORE; cost_centers: CC-SEARCH, CC-PLAY, CC-ADS.

ellie: running rebill script now. Preview:
``
core-search,2100,LDG-CORE,CC-SEARCH
platform-playground,1250,LDG-CORE,CC-PLAY
ads-ml,920,LDG-CORE,CC-ADS
```

billing-bot: JE created JE-2026-APAC-US-3305000000 attached: https://redwood.internal/journal/JE-2026-APAC-US-3305000000.csv. Linked to FIN-2026-410.

raj (finance): audit note saved. Follow-up: eng to add unit test for billing key rename and a watch that alerts on unknown keys > $500.

mike-ops: opening infra ticket for mapper tests + watch. Closing thread once infra PR merged.
notes: Provider renamed billing label key causing mapper to drop owner tags; heuristic/fallback allocation used for confident matches; JIRA + JE created; low-confidence lines retained as unallocated; eng follow-up for mapper tests and alerting.
